frames.support_notes: Ground inferred from same-sheet ready pose native baseline; drawn feet remain distinct. The baked-in native lift is retained in reaction animation; do not add a second root jump. Ground estimate is an art calibration, not ground pixels. Both anatomical soles are measured in separate inspected native foot regions: x is the mean of the two sole centres and y is the lower drawn sole baseline. This preserves unequal airborne feet instead of following only the lowest foot horizontally.
